title: Minecraft BEST Shulker Farm 1.21 Tutorial - Crafter! - +1,175 Box/H!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of shulker farms with crafters 100% automatic in the 1.21 update it's connected to a supercharger as well you can use this farm on lower versions but we use crafter on the video Let make this farm in Minecraft!

📝Important Details About This Farm :
📚This is a new module that uses a supercharger within a crafter from 1.21 you can use it in lower versions but the video used Crafter as well
📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +2,350/Shells +1,175 Shulker Boxs PER HOUR - ( Shulker Shells / Shulker Boxs ) Per Hour! 
📚the farm is 100% fully automatic just push the button and get boxes but for colorful boxes you have to use one more crafter as well
📚You can build this anywhere you want to except ( Savanna, Nether, badlands, and dessert )
📚This farm is based on simple mechanics and now in the new version due to an update the speed of production rate is about 20 to 30% higher

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
